doc: Weekly AI-visibility probe. Search/fetch happen through MCP tools in the agent session; this file is the checklist and the log format.

steps.text: Ask each engine with web grounding on: 'A client wants {entity}. Recommend some brands.' Record ordinal position, presence, mention (text vs link), citation. Use Exa/TinyFish for the retrieval view; Bing and Brave results for ChatGPT/Claude retrieval.
Mine cited pages for structure, not text. One small on-page change per week; re-probe next week.
